predictions.why: Under one difficulty axis plus sampling, the contested problems are mid-difficulty items where right and wrong answers split, so 4 more draws only cut sampling noise: the honest 4-vote of 446 rises about as far as a full 8-vote would (Wang's maj@4 to maj@8 is about +2.5 points, roughly 458). The post-hoc tie_short gain already counted in 453 is partly given back, and the result stays well below pass@4 of 467 because problems where the base solves 0 of 4 do not move.
